scripts.dev: npm run build:calculator && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @temt/web" "npm run dev -w @temt/api"
scripts.build:web: npm run build:calculator && npm run build -w @temt/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:calculator && npm run build -w @temt/api
scripts.build: npm run build:calculator && npm run build -w @temt/api && npm run build -w @temt/web
scripts.check: npm run build:calculator && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
